_comment: Thesis themes. `terms` auto-assign posts (same syntax as lexicon.json); `seeds` in seeds.json pin hand-curated keystone posts. Edit thesis statements freely - they are your working hypotheses.

stablecoin-rails.title: Stablecoins & payment rails
stablecoin-rails.thesis: Stablecoins are crypto's proven PMF and are becoming the settlement layer for cards, cross-border B2B and eventually agentic payments; distribution (Stripe/Tempo, banks, wallets) decides who captures it.
drivers: card programs built on stablecoin settlement
shadow-economy B2B usage (e.g. India-China trade in USDT)
issuer concentration risk (80% of crypto cards on one issuer)
Tether/Circle profitability as the industry's revenue anchor

tokenization-rwa.title: Tokenized equities & RWAs
tokenization-rwa.thesis: Tokenized stocks repeat the stablecoin curve (24/7 settlement + global access to 4B unbrokered people); the open questions are borrow-side demand, and whether the onchain layer captures any of the value it creates.
drivers: RFQ mint/redeem replacing AMMs for equities

regulatory-unlock.title: US regulatory unlock
regulatory-unlock.thesis: SEC's token framework (retail sales up to $5M/$75M, exit from investment-contract regime) plus Clarity re-onshores founders and could restart compliant public token distribution - the single biggest cycle catalyst.
drivers: Clarity act momentum incl. Wall St backing

value-accrual.title: Token value accrual & revenue businesses
value-accrual.thesis: The investable set collapsed to tokens of real revenue businesses doing buybacks or routing fees; token/equity misalignment makes most of the rest uninvestable, and some builders should skip tokens entirely.
drivers: 'up only' buyback tokens in a bear market
fee routing to L1 tokens from permissionless protocols
companies staying tokenless like startups staying private

market-structure.title: Onchain market structure
market-structure.thesis: Crypto converges on four PMF markets (spot/memes, perps, yield, predictions) plus stablecoin payments; AMMs lose to orderbooks/RFQ/dark pools as professionals arrive, and everyone races to build the everything-exchange.
drivers: AMM structural critique from HFT operators

cycle-capital-rotation.title: Cycle timing & capital rotation
cycle-capital-rotation.thesis: Crypto is in its post-dot-com chapter: prices lag while fundamentals compound; the trade is positioning for capital rotating back from AI, with $7B of fresh crypto VC dry powder already raised.
drivers: opportunity cost vs AI keeps sentiment at lows
narrative arc: SoV -> ICOs -> DeFi -> memes -> the financial system onchain
post-GENIUS institutional adoption regardless of price

vc-mechanics.title: VC & fund mechanics
vc-mechanics.thesis: Fund structure explains fund behavior: GPs are middlemen for LP interests, which punishes non-consensus theses and rewards momentum; emerging managers and family offices are the structural alpha in a dislocated market.
drivers: GP/LP incentive chain shapes what gets funded
emerging manager survival playbook (early first close, tiny checks)

fintech-credit-wedge.title: Fintech wave 2: credit & vertical wedges
fintech-credit-wedge.thesis: Fintech's next wave is credit plus industry-specific workflow wedges - own a vertical's financial workflow (e.g. AI medical billing), monetize with the banking/credit stack under it; consolidation with tradfi is the endgame.
drivers: credit as the neobank customer-acquisition weapon
AI-native workflow companies collapsing service costs 5-6% -> 2-3%
proprietary underwriting data from owning the revenue cycle

ai-crypto-convergence.title: AI x crypto convergence
ai-crypto-convergence.thesis: Billions of transacting AI agents need payment rails the legacy system can't provide - the machine economy is the use case that finally drives blockchain adoption, and AI red-team/defense agents become table stakes for shipping software.
drivers: Franklin Templeton naming agents the blockchain use case
24/7 AI attack/defense agents on open-source financial code
what AI must consume: compute, energy, data, rails

consumer-speculation.title: Consumer crypto & speculation
consumer-speculation.thesis: Speculation is the eternal consumer wedge - social trading apps, prediction markets and internet-culture coins are the onboarding surface; the design question is incentive structures that don't strip-mine retail.
drivers: onchain social trading apps at 100k+ DAUs
consumer hypergamblification as an investable input
memecoin cohorts burning retail vs healthier predictions/BTC onboarding

adoption-barriers.title: Adoption barriers & UX debt
adoption-barriers.thesis: The bull case's biggest risk is unresolved UX debt: self-custody is too much responsibility for normal people, security failures compound distrust, and memecoin-first onboarding burns each retail cohort it touches.
drivers: financial inclusion as the durable counter-case
